clips.title: The story
paras: Cookie is an elite murloc serving as the ship's cook aboard the juggernaut hidden deep within the Deadmines. An unusual recruit among the Defias Brotherhood, he tends the crew's cauldrons beneath the watchful eye of Captain Greenskin and Edwin VanCleef. He is the only entirely optional boss encountered within the underground dry dock.

Beneath the decks of the towering juggernaut in the Ironclad Cove, cooking duty falls neither to a human outrider nor a goblin engineer, but to a solitary murloc known simply as Cookie. How he secured the position remains a private secret kept by Edwin VanCleef himself. Whatever doubts the rest of the crew might harbor about a murloc presiding over their rations, pirates are rarely in a position to be picky, and in the underworld of Moonbrook, a meal is a meal.
